challenge_signature_definition: ordered normal objectives/quantities + timer + VIP enabled/level/quantity

classification_definitions.ANALYTICAL_TIMER_RATIO_OUTLIER: absolute timer/cost ratio deviation from cohort median is greater than 5 percent
classification_definitions.HIGH_RISK_SOLVER_FAILURE: exact class received five fresh canonical-scale trials and zero completed; this V06 one-trial screen does not assign it
classification_definitions.MATHEMATICALLY_UNREACHABLE: mandatory target is outside legal L1-L3 equal-merge closure or structurally invalid
classification_definitions.SCREENING_FAILURE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: fewer than five canonical-scale trials failed to complete; not an impossibility claim
classification_definitions.SOLVER_FEASIBLE: at least one of five fresh canonical-scale MERGE_AWARE_V01 trials completed
classification_definitions.VIP_INTERCEPTION_RISK_HISTORICAL_ONLY: historical V04 analytical risk retained as a labeled non-post-fix classification

interpretation_boundary: Every V06 decision trial uses MERGE_AWARE_V01 at Engine.time_scale = 1.0.
One completion demonstrates one solver-feasible path, not human difficulty or owner acceptance.
A failed trial is screening evidence only; exact-class 0/5 is HIGH_RISK_SOLVER_FAILURE, not proof of impossibility.
Post-V05 reserve evidence uses bridge-authoritative normal_remaining and indivisible equal-level reserve semantics.
Historical V04 VIP interception risk remains historical and is excluded from post-V05 mandatory classification.
No timer, normal objective, VIP content, or canonical data tuning is authorized by this report.

post_v05_vip_summary.historical_v04_risk_label: historical only; never reclassified as post-V05 mandatory
